programmes.d: Things get heated between swimmers CK and Kenneth as they compete for the Inter-varsity Games.
Bryan runs for Vice-President; Priya learns that everyone is voting for superficial reasons.
Adam and Beth try to escape from the clutches of the Colonel's men.
The children have their final showdown with the Colonel to see who will prevail.
Shang Xue and Junzhe are caught in the rain and share a sweet moment. Junzhe is shocked to discover Shang Xue living in Yuze's block when he sends her home.
Belle ties Shang Xue up and nearly pushes her off the balcony. Junzhe arrives in time to save Shang Xue and takes her to the archery range to take her mind off things.
Kai Ting discovers Jia Hao's dad embezzled Jin Tang's funds; he's beaten to death by loan sharks.
Ke Xuan and Hao Jie move into a mansion; the couple supports each other as their parents hurt them.
Fung Lan has to make the right decision now that the search for the spy intensifies.
The murders have been resolved.
A shophouse in Singapore catches Chi Ling's attention, as she returns to claim its inheritance.
A young entitled client ruffles things up at the House of Phoenix, hurting one of the girls.

The police discover that Indah is a drug mule and there are drugs hidden in her body.
Kun Jie receives a call from Zeus that The Vigilante is on her car, and she is shocked.
Gina is killed by a masked man. Yinxi remembers Mercy saying that the mastermind is someone from RSB, and thinks that it is Ruixiang, putting Yinchen in a spot.
Yinchen breaks up with Ruixiang. Yalian tells Yinchen about the death of Ruixiang's ex-fiancee Xiaomin, hoping Yinchen could give him another chance.
Bryan and Priya run against each other in the Cempaka Hall Student Management Committee elections.
Zarina and Desiree are at odds; Zarina finds comfort in her budding friendship with Si En.
Francis and David are up for tenure; David is full of confidence.
The silo explodes and Mother is injured. The siblings decide if they should venture into the world.
They investigate what the mysterious word "allies" inscribed on Faye's body means.
Jin Xin suspects Junzhe is involved in Yuze's disappearance but nobody believes him. Shang Xue and Junzhe have a lovely date at the garden. However, Shang Xue falls out with Junzhe over Yuze.

Junzhe sees Shang Xue flirting with Eddy and thinks that she is cheating on him like Yuze did. Shang Xue finds a snake at home and turns to the security guard Mr Wu for help when Junzhe doesn't answer her calls.
Hao Jie's mom dies from a fall; Ke Xuan recalls Hao Jie's argument with Lu Ah Yi, who also fell.
Ke Xuan finds a psychologist's report, and discovers he has Dissociative Identity Disorder.
A new chief inspector is in town, and he is determined to get behind the murders in the district.
The House of Phoenix is a flurry of activities in the mornings, showing the other side of things.
Chi Ling's past is further unveiled through a series of discovered stories.
